# SFCC-748 — Breadcrumb and SEO (Contentful content type)

**Mechanically, this is the smallest story of the five.** `scripts/contentful/buildTemplate.js` discovers content types by **directory scan** (`fs.readdirSync` over `scripts/contentful/content-types/`) — there is no index, manifest, or registration list. Dropping a file in *is* the registration.

**To ship one content type:**
1. Add `scripts/contentful/content-types/categorySeo.js`
2. `npm run sync:contentful -- --version-name "SFCC-748 categorySeo"`
3. `npm run install:contentful -- --target dev --dry-run`, then for real; repeat per env in order `dev → test → sit → staging → uat → master`

Plus by convention: `overrides/app/types/contentful.ts` (add `CategorySeoEntry`), a `useCategorySeo.ts` hook + test, a render component + test + story, mount it in `product-list/index.tsx`, and regenerate `.claude/registry/*.md`.

**The exact precedent to copy is `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/scripts/contentful/content-types/sizeGuide.js` + `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/hooks/useSizeGuide.ts`** — a `key` Symbol with `unique` + `regexp` validation, fetched via a `fields.key[in]=` filter through `useContentfulEntries`, narrowed by `pickMostSpecificByRegion(entries, siteId)` from `overrides/app/utils/resolveByRegion.ts`. Arbitrary field filtering **already works with zero hook changes** — `fields.categoryId=X` would work today.

12 content types exist: `footerConfig`, `headerNavItem`, `headerNavigation`, `iconAndText`, `iconAndTextItem`, `image`, `link`, `navGroup`, `region`, `sizeGuide`, `sizeGuideTable`, `uiCopy`. **None keys off a category ID.** `region.siteId` (`unique: true`, not localized) is the only existing SFCC-identifier field and is the right validation shape to copy — but note `region` here means *storefront*, not geography.

**What SFCC-748 genuinely adds:**
1. A Contentful rich-text renderer (see SFCC-749 above — shared cost).
2. **The first localized RichText field in the content model.** No existing type has one; both existing RichText fields are `localized: false`. Editor translation workflow for rich text is unproven here.
3. A decision on locale strategy that **contradicts the established house pattern**: `sizeGuide.js`'s description says *"Locale is encoded in the entry key — do not use Contentful field-level localisation."* SFCC-748's "locale support" needs an explicit call on which way it goes.

**Contentful locale state:** 10 locales provisioned (`en` default, `en-US`, `en-CA`, `en-GB`, `fr`, `it`, `es`, `en-CH`, `en-HK`, `en-AE`), all falling back to `en`. 11 sites → 10 locales (`en-GB` serves both UK and EU-English). Three disagreeing "defaults" in code: `CONTENTFUL_FALLBACK_LOCALE = 'en-US'`, `DEFAULT_LOCALE = 'en'`, space default `en`. Worth settling before a localized SEO body ships.

**Gate cost people miss:** CODEOWNERS:148 routes `scripts/contentful/content-types/` to **tier-2-approvers AND tier-1-approvers**. A one-file story carries a Tier 1 review.

**Build from scratch**

Flags are not in `ZimmIcon`'s closed `ICON_MAP` either — a dedicated `ZimmFlag` atom keyed by ISO code is the sane shape.
- The sticky-footer layout, the selector organism + recipe, and the search field.

**Ignore the base `locale-selector`** (`node_modules/.../components/locale-selector/index.jsx`, 124 lines): wrong interaction model (nested accordion, `CheckIcon` not radio), and structurally inert here — both consumers gate on `supportedLocaleIds?.length > 1`, and **every Zimmermann site has exactly one locale**. **Copy-first: none required**, assuming you don't take the base locale-selector.

**Structural consequence worth stating plainly:** each PWA site has one locale and one currency, so the "language selector" is **not a locale switch within a site — it's a site switch across four PWA sites** (`ZimmermannEUen/fr/it/es`). `onConfirm(country, locale)` must resolve to `(targetAlias, targetLocale)` and hard-navigate.

   - `.docs/prd/plp.md:19` (SPR-04, Confirmed 2026-05-08): *"Configurable title, description, and hero image per category page **via Business Manager**."*
   
   SFCC-748 says Contentful. Both PRDs say SFCC/BM, and the field schema is explicitly still Open pending Sparro. **This is a stop-and-ask, not a build.**

# Shared implementation surface — blunt

**Tier 1 overlap: SFCC-743 → SFCC-874. Build back-to-back, 743 first.**
874 = 743's section header + 743's responsive grid engine, *plus* a lookbook slot, one `VARIATION_CONFIG` row for Editorial, and two prop passthroughs (`showControls` already exists; `showSlideIndicator` is one new optional prop on `zimmProductCardMedia`). Concretely reused: the new section-header component, the new column-count/tablet-cap layout primitive, `ZimmProductCard`, `ZimmProductCardMedia` (carousel, complete), `ZimmSlideIndicator`, `zimmProductCardShared.ts`, and whichever card mapper you settle on. **Built in the other order, you pay for the grid engine and header twice.** Built separately by different people, you get a fourth and fifth divergent "row of cards."

**Tier 2 overlap: SFCC-748 → SFCC-749. 748 first, but only just.**
748 is the data contract for *half* of 749. The two genuinely shared build items are (a) the **Contentful rich-text renderer**, which does not exist and neither story can ship its SEO half without, and (b) the `useCategorySeo` hook modelled on `useSizeGuide.ts`. **749's breadcrumb half is fully independent of 748** — it can start immediately and in parallel, since its data (`parentCategoryTree`, `overrides/app/utils/url.ts` helpers) is already on the page.

**Tier 3 overlap: 743/874 → 748, if the card groups are Contentful-authored.**
`overrides/app/components/contentful/experiences/definitions.ts` currently calls `defineComponents([])` — **zero components registered**, and `generateDefinitions.mjs` `process.exit(1)`s when it finds none. If `display`/`size`/`grid`/`qty`/`cardType` are Studio Experiences variables, 743 and 874 are the **first real registrations** and share that entire setup cost (the `@cf-register` + `@cf` JSDoc convention, `npm run generate:contentful`, and the `generate:contentful:check` CI gate).

**SFCC-801 is the outlier — it shares almost nothing with the other four.** Its reuse comes from already-shipped infrastructure (`zimmDrawer`, `zimmAccordion`, `crossSiteUrl`, `useCountryConfig`, `EU_LANGUAGE_CONFIG`), not from anything the other four produce. Its two new shared assets — a `ZimmRadio`/`ZimmCountryRow` atom and an `allowMultiple`/controlled `ZimmAccordion` — benefit nothing else in this set. **Schedule it independently; it has no sequencing dependency on the other four in either direction.** Its real dependencies are data and design decisions (region mapping, country names, 6 flags, currency contradiction), not code.

**One cross-cutting item that will bite if ignored:** four `ui-kits` components currently ship with **no theme recipe at all** — `zimmCheckbox`, `zimmSelectedChip`, `zimmSizeFilter`, `zimmCheckboxGroup` (all inline `sx`, all newly landed via release/v0.2.0). Also note `recipeGuards.test.ts` test #6: **any new recipe key must be `Zimm`-prefixed** or it silently deep-merges a base SFCC recipe of the same name — the `INTENTIONAL_MERGES` allowlist is only `['Button', 'Header', 'ListMenu']`.
